title: On Dismissing the class an hour early
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：dismiss　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dismiss 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the postman ① dismissed the class an hour early before dawn, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② dismisses the class an hour early in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ dismiss the class an hour early at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ dismissed the class an hour early before — a line in the list for June 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Dismissing the class an hour early before dawn, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ dismiss the whole idea at once in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Dismiss the whole idea at once at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ dismisses the whole idea at once before dawn every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ dismissed the class an hour early again when nobody else would.

⑩ To dismiss the class an hour early, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody dismisses the class an hour early in public again and somebody must dismiss the class an hour early before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 解散（一般过去式 dismissed the class an hour early：1976 年邮差头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 解散（一般现在 dismisses the class an hour early：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 解散（不定式 to dismiss the class an hour early：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 解散（过去完成时 had dismissed the class an hour early：1970 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 解散（动名词 dismissing the class an hour early 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 不考虑（dismiss the whole idea at once：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去不考虑当场就把这主意否了）
G. v. 不考虑（dismiss the whole idea at once：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 解散（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 dismisses the whole idea at once，而母亲又一次 dismissed the class an hour early）

answers.why: dismiss 意为“解散”，1976 年邮差天没亮就解散提前一个钟头放学，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 dismissed。
dismiss 意为“解散”，自那以后邮差当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 dismisses。
dismiss 意为“解散”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯解散提前一个钟头放学”，此处为不定式 to dismiss the class an hour early。
dismiss 意为“解散”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1983 年之前就有人解散过，故用过去完成时 had dismissed。
dismiss 意为“解散”，邮差说“解散提前一个钟头放学这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 dismissing the class an hour early 作主语。
dismiss 意为“不考虑”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去不考虑当场就把这主意否了”，should ever 之后用原形 dismiss the whole idea at once。
dismiss 意为“不考虑”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻不考虑当场就把这主意否了（dismiss the whole idea at once at once），以后再也不要提起。
dismiss 意为“解散”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例不考虑当场就把这主意否了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 dismisses。
dismiss 意为“解散”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就解散提前一个钟头放学，用一般过去式 dismissed 叙述。
dismiss 意为“解散”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要解散提前一个钟头放学，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 dismiss 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the postman dismissed the class an hour early before dawn, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman dismisses the class an hour early in public whenever the office asks.
Dismissing the class an hour early before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever dismiss the whole idea at once in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office dismisses the whole idea at once before dawn every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother dismissed the class an hour early again, and the office remembered that half.
